_provenance.how: solc 0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a --combined-json abi,bin-runtime,hashes, one entry per compiler setting; vyper entries from vyper -f abi,bytecode_runtime
_provenance.why: the selectors a runtime dispatches must equal the selectors of its own ABI; these are checked-in cases of that relation, so the suite needs no compiler
_provenance.hashes: solc's own signature-to-selector map, kept as ground truth for canonicalisation
